items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: that’s what Miles used to say, right?

ctx.x: You can bet it’s going to be a short one. I don’t have no music. I left my music at the hotel. I don’t need it.
Don’t need it. So it’s going to be a short one. Well rehearse on the gig, that’s what Miles used to say, right?
I want Braille. I want Braille blues.
